generation_procedure.step_1: Author independent task families disjoint from T1, T2, all development inputs, and all smoke inputs; record author identities and contamination limits.
generation_procedure.step_2: Freeze each task's prompt bytes, starting artifact tree SHA, expected interface, and independent grader (identity + revision + SHA-256) before any model sees any task.
generation_procedure.step_3: Balance the design: equal tasks per family (3), 10 repetitions per task, schedule seeds 20260914..20260923.
generation_procedure.step_4: Compute per-task SHA-256, workload byte SHA-256, and manifest hash over the canonical FrozenWorkload schema (residual.eval_frozen.workload).
generation_procedure.step_5: Fill every BLOCKED-UNTIL-GENERATED slot in this manifest in a single commit; retain the manifest SHA-256 through the external commitment channel before outcome access.
generation_procedure.step_6: Any correction after generation requires a new corpus version and preserves v1 artifacts; never edit based on observed verifier or model behavior.
